causes.label: demand
causes.quote: Demand was high during the evening peak, driven by extremely cold weather increasing heating requirements.

causes.label: demand
causes.quote: New South Wales hit its highest winter peak demand since 2010 at around 13,000 MW.

causes.label: scheduled_plant_outage
causes.quote: Almost 3,300 MW of that capacity was on planned outage, which was expected as generators generally undertake maintenance in autumn before returning to service for the winter peak from mid- to late-June.

causes.label: unscheduled_plant_outage
causes.quote: The remaining 1,800 MW of capacity of unplanned outages was all in Queensland. Most of this capacity had been out since the significant failure of the Callide C 4 unit on 25 May 2021.

causes.label: unscheduled_plant_outage
causes.quote: AGL Energy removed 300 MW of capacity from Liddell at 12.28 pm due to coal quality issues and then a further 30 MW effective 6 pm due to milling limits.

causes.label: interconnector_limit
causes.quote: No further imports could be sourced from Victoria, as the VIC -NSW interconnector was already operating at or close to its nominal limit.

causes.label: fcas_co_optimisation
causes.quote: requirements for mainland raise FCAS services reduced the effective amount of low- priced capacity available to meet demand in the energy market.

causes.label: fcas_co_optimisation
causes.quote: This trade-off between the provision of FCAS and energy effectively reduced low priced capacity by up to 60 MW and contributed to high dispatch prices.

interconnectors_named.name: VIC-NSW
interconnectors_named.quote: No further imports could be sourced from Victoria, as the VIC -NSW interconnector was already operating at or close to its nominal limit.

intervals.quote: On 10 June the spot price in New South Wales exceeded $5,000/MWh for the 6 pm and 6.30 pm trading intervals, and in Queensland for the 6 pm trading interval.

peak_price.quote: The spot price in New South Wales was $8,022/MWh and $5,027/MWh for the 6 pm and 6.30 pm trading intervals respectively.

rebid_set_price.quote: Rebidding of capacity from low to high prices did not contribute to prices above $5,000/MWh.
